caption: Houston beta party: Jan 9. A paddle boat date went in circles until a duck passed them. Then they made a plan: one steers, one pedals. Who steers in your relationship?

caption: Houston beta party: Jan 9. Pisces almost stayed on the couch. The stars showed up, someone said just show up, and the first person there said they almost didn't come either. Who are you bringing?

caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Being late on 59 again? Your star has a fix, and it is kinder than you think. Send this to the friend who is always 20 minutes away.

caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Sunday dinner in Pearland turned into an auntie council. They only ask because they love you.
Send this to the cousin who gets asked every Sunday.

Scorpio, the deep scroll is not the move. Ask them over coffee instead. Send this to the Scorpio who knows everyone's 2019.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Gemini and Sagittarius called your whole bayou date live. One real question saved it.
What's your favorite spot in Houston? Tell us below.

caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
A brunch line is a whole date if you let them talk. Tag the Leo with the best brunch outfit.

Send this to the friend who laminates the plan.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Yes, the sausage one is a klobasnek. Maybe save that for the third date. Kolache or klobasnek: what is your order?

caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Pisces planned a Galveston day: brown water, a pelican, a sunset on the seawall. Everybody cried.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Crying at the bats at sunset is valid. Then say how you feel, in plain words. Send this to your Pisces.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Leo dragged you through Montrose and EaDo for the perfect mural photo. A grackle got the best shot.
Which Houston mural is your favorite?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Katy to Montrose with soup, again? Love should meet you halfway. Inside or outside the Loop: where are you?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Construction, a closed exit, a Texas U-turn and Kuykendahl. Aries finally texted before, not after.

Run club is not a race and neither is love. Match their pace. Tag the Aries who laps everyone on the bayou trail.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.

Flour or corn? Settle it below.

Six food stops on Bellaire is a lot. Pick one and stay long enough to talk. What is your one Bellaire stop?

Where'd you go to high school? Comment it.

Forty minutes in Rice Village and still no restaurant. Saying what you want is kind. Libras: comment your pick.

Taurus would not share the breakfast taco. The next morning they showed up with your exact order.
Send this to the person who knows your taco order.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
The office AC is arctic and you are still there. Put the date on the calendar, then show up to it. Send this to your hardest-working friend.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Libra walked all of Bellaire Blvd and couldn't pick. One honest answer and it was dumplings.
What's your go-to on Bellaire?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Free museum day is a great date. Say how you feel, not just what the art means. Tag the Aquarius who explains the frame.

caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Aquarius took Gemini somewhere very quiet in Montrose. Minute nine changed everything.
Tag your loudest friend.

hook: Sag, before you drive to Galveston again…
caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Galveston at 9pm is a whole mood. Invite them next time. Sag, where is your favorite day trip?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Sag said 20 minutes. It was Sugar Land, then Katy, then a playlist trade. Best drive ever.
How far is 20 minutes in Houston? Be honest.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
The porch, the dog, the same coffee forever. Go see their side of town, then bring them home. Heights people, when did you last leave?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Run club, brunch, pickleball, crawfish and karaoke in one Saturday. Gemini learned to say a kind no.
Send this to the friend who never says no.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
One date in and the boat is already planned. Fall for who shows up. Send this to the Pisces staring at the water.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.

Who always has the extra sweater?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
You sang every word at them, then said it was just a song. Say it without the backing track. What is your karaoke song?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Libra washed the car twice for the date. Oak pollen won. Their date showed up yellow too.
Tag someone whose car is yellow right now.

Where did you go to high school? Great start. Now ask a follow-up. So, where did you go to high school?

caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Aries and Capricorn raced a paddle boat at Hermann Park and got passed by a turtle.
Who would you paddle with?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Sixty degrees and you made soup for everyone. Let someone bring you the pho this time. Tag the Cancer who feeds the group.

Who taught you how to peel crawfish?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
The candy paint and the trunk sign are a lot of love. Steady texts every week are too. Send this to the Leo with the big gestures.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Scorpio swore they weren't scared of the bats at sunset. Then the bats came out.
Have you seen the bats? Comment your sign.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Seven color-coded tabs for one date. Plan the start, leave the rest open, and bring the sweater. Virgos, how many tabs is yours?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Gemini tried to meet in the downtown tunnels on a Saturday. Closed. Then everyone got lost on Monday.
Send this to the friend who says meet you there.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
You both waited for the other to lead the whole song. Take turns. Who leads at two-step night, you or them?

Run club or walk club? Pick one.

Missed the exit in an argument? Houston gave you the Texas U-turn. Send this to the Aries who floors it.

What's your karaoke song?

Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Five-year plans can wait. Ask about their best taco ever. Capricorns, what is your real first-date question?

Free museum night: Capricorn saw a rectangle, Aquarius saw a feeder road at sunset. One question changed it.
What do you see in it? Be honest.

Send this to your group chat.

Who in your family would win?

January crawfish are small and early feelings are too. Let it grow. Comment your crawfish order.

Houston beta party: Jan 9.

caption: Houston beta party: Jan 9. Tomorrow. Pisces can't sleep, the city glow hides the stars, and it turns out everyone is awake too. Come as you are. See you tomorrow, Houston.
